loader: Existing selected-army source index; one immutable catalog per process. Native units instantiated fresh and deep-copied by Section02Definitions. Definition digest unchanged at teardown.
constructed_contracts: Core single-target coverage proves the complete declared target inventory; individual faction single-target abilities remain their content owners.

Current Core contracts absent from supported native content are labeled explicitly: CLOSE-QUARTERS, Hunter, critical4/BS5, characteristics/rules contrasts, record-only against trigger, allocated Damage-1, attack-specific Hazardous, zero-equipment melee body.

Replacement starts with accepted declarations and an explicitly supplied post-declaration geometry change; it does not certify the separate granting move rule.
Native definitions have retained bridge source provenance; these tests do not claim competitive legal roster certification or original paper datasheet conformance beyond loader-supported content.
mission_dependency: Actual cached Warhammer Event Companion mission authority is required by the facade shooting Action gate. Terrain is removed for clear-line combat; authentic objectives and matching force-disposition metadata remain. No mission playthrough. This one cold dependency is timed separately.
state_scope: Fresh combat GameState/placement/decision graphs at SHOOTING or FIGHT boundary. Fight state starts at relevant Fight step, without simulating Charge/Pile In. Minimal non-strict roster/config identity metadata is not execution of mustering and not a legal army certification.
isolation: Fresh mutable graphs and casualty/condition isolation control, per-session catalog digest, cached mission payload equality. Physical weapon IDs from supported rows, correct ownership and native model geometry retained.
unavailable_native_attempts: Hellblasters and Dark Reapers lack required retained representative height data. The loader correctly rejected them. No geometry override or bypass was added; supported Noise Marines solve the multi-bearer profile case.
unused_definitions_removed: Maulerfiend and Wave Serpent were exploratory only and are absent from the final six-definition fixture.
